STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_185509.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_185509.v · Open raw
module origen_185509(
    input we,
    input [7:0] w_data,
    input [7:0] b_addr,
    input [7:0] a_addr,
    input [7:0] r_addr,
    input [7:0] w_addr,
    input clk1,
    input clk2,
    input swap,
    input reset,
    output [7:0] r_data
);

reg [1:0] cur_state, next_state;
reg [1:0] sel;
reg w;
reg [7:0] Reg [0:255];

reg [7:0] l12_b_addr, l12_a_addr, l12_r_addr, l12_w_addr, l12_w_data;
reg l12_w;

reg [7:0] l23_b_addr, l23_a_addr, l23_r_addr, l23_w_addr, l23_w_data;
reg l23_w;

reg [7:0] l34_r_data;

always @(posedge clk1 or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        cur_state <= 'b0;
    end else begin
        cur_state <= next_state;
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    next_state = cur_state;
    case (cur_state)
        'b00: begin
            if (swap) begin
                next_state = 'b01;
            end
        end
        'b01: begin
            next_state = 'b10;
        end
        'b10: begin
            next_state = 'b11;
        end
        'b11: begin
            next_state = 'b00;
        end
    endcase
end

always @(*) begin
    case (cur_state)
        'b00: begin
            sel = 'b00;
        end
        'b01: begin
            sel = 'b01;
        end
        'b10: begin
            sel = 'b10;
        end
        'b11: begin
            sel = 'b11;
        end
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk1) begin
    l12_b_addr <= b_addr;
    l12_a_addr <= a_addr;
    l12_r_addr <= r_addr;
    l12_w_addr <= w_addr;
    l12_w_data <= w_data;
    l12_w <= we;
end

always @(posedge clk2) begin
    l23_b_addr <= l12_b_addr;
    l23_a_addr <= l12_a_addr;
    l23_r_addr <= l12_r_addr;
    l23_w_addr <= l12_w_addr;
    l23_w_data <= l12_w_data;
    l23_w <= l12_w;
end

always @(posedge clk2) begin
    if (l23_w) begin
        Reg[l23_r_addr] <= l23_w_data;
    end else begin
        l34_r_data <= Reg[l23_r_addr];
    end
end

assign r_data = l34_r_data;

endmodule
